findings.evidence: The new `IsTotallyReal` (Basic.lean:35, no `@[expose]`) is constructed and consumed across modules purely via `(isTotallyReal_iff _ _).2 (...)` in Lagrangian/TotallyReal.lean:93-95; all `IsMaximalTotallyReal` consumers (Symplectic/Finrank.lean:94, Symplectic/TotallyReal.lean:48-60) use accessors or `rw`+`exact`, never a defeq unfold.
findings.fix: Drop `@[expose]` from `IsMaximalTotallyReal`, matching the parallel `IsTotallyReal` def which has no `@[expose]`.
findings.issue: `IsMaximalTotallyReal` is `@[expose] def`, exposing its `IsCompl` body downstream, but no consumer unfolds it: every use goes through `isMaximalTotallyReal_iff` and the accessors (`isCompl`, `disjoint`, `two_mul_finrank_eq`, etc.). This is an over-exposed body kept where the characteristic API already suffices.

findings.evidence: `not_isMaximalTotallyReal_of_odd_finrank` body is `fun hL => (Nat.not_odd_iff_even.2 (hL.even_finrank hJ)) h` — a one-line consequence of `even_finrank`; no consumer grep hit outside the file.
findings.fix: Drop it, or keep only if a downstream target needs the non-existence phrasing; otherwise let `even_finrank` stand.
findings.issue: `not_isMaximalTotallyReal_of_odd_finrank` is a speculative public lemma with no roadmap consumer; its content is already delivered by `even_finrank` (odd finrank ⇒ ¬Even ⇒ no maximal subspace), so it duplicates existing API.

summary: Characteristic API for both predicates is complete and correctly annotated, and bodies are otherwise hidden. Two API points: an unnecessary `@[expose]` on `IsMaximalTotallyReal`, and a redundant public corollary.
